quotes.text: I stand in solidarity with @sagaftra, @WGAEast, and @WGAWest, who are striking against existential threats to their professions. From AI and Mini Rooms, to unfair streaming residuals, studios have employed a business model rooted in exploiting their workforce. https://t.co/vcI8HQuWEh
Right now, AIPAC, crypto and AI is spending millions and millions of dollars trying to influence election 2026,

Seemingly overnight, and without public consent, major technology companies have embedded artificial intelligence (AI) into the bedrock of daily life. [...] As long as tech billionaires are permitted to amass unchecked profits from this new technology, AI’s influence will only expand — regardless of the harms it inflicts on working people and the planet. We cannot stand by while a handful of CEOs reshape our entire economy to further concentrate wealth and power. As your representative in Congress, Claire will fight to hold major technology corporations accountable, protect our workforce from the harms of AI, and ensure that new technologies benefit communities, not just corporate executives.

Claire will fight to put a moratorium on AI data center expansion. Claire will cosponsor the proposed bill from Senator Sanders and Representative Ocasio-Cortez that would place a moratorium on new data center development contingent on several safeguards being in place, including worker protections related to job displacement, effects on energy prices, and climate impacts. As a member of the Assembly, she has cosponsored a similar moratorium here in the state.

I strongly support @BernieSanders’ call to pause construction of new AI data centers until stronger regulations are in place. Technology must work for working people, not just oligarchs. https://t.co/Sau83QMvQz
